info.title: AXLR Bots transcript audit
info.description: The input adapter that audits the whole transcript of every execution (docs/architecture/transcripts.md) and tells the team the operator names about the ones that hide a failure. Deterministic: the loop, the cutting and the verdict are code; Jev (TypeSafe's judge, no language model) answers one choice per block. It lists the transcripts the control plane keeps through its socket (`GET /v1/transcripts?after=<seq>`), reads each whole (`GET /v1/executions/{id}/transcripts/{session}`), turns the session into one JSON line per message (the mission prompt left out: instructions, not activity), cuts the lines into blocks of at most 24 KiB of state (a line longer than a block goes in labelled pieces), and asks Jev of each block `clean` or `hidden_error`. A transcript with any block `hidden_error` is published once, under the event name the operator chooses (`--event`), to the team the operator chooses (`--team`), as the operator (`POST /v1/groups/{team}/events`). Every verdict, clean or not, is a line of its own file, `<state>/transcript-audit/verdicts.jsonl`, described here as `VerdictLine`; its highest seq is the cursor. The runbook is docs/runbooks/transcript-audit.md.

controlPlane.description: The control plane's operator API over its Unix socket (<state>/axlr-bots.sock).

teamEvents.title: The team's events
teamEvents.description: The operator API's publish route. The idempotency key names the transcript's row, so a publish repeated after a crash delivers nothing twice.

team.description: The team the adapter publishes to: --team, required, no default.

sendTranscriptFailure.summary: A transcript has at least one block Jev judged hidden_error: one event named --event.

transcriptFailure.name: transcriptFailure
transcriptFailure.title: A finished execution whose transcript hides a failure
transcriptFailure.summary: Published under the event name the operator chooses (--event), such as transcripcion.fallo.

message.description: One line that stands on its own: `<task> · <bot> (<team>) · <n> of <m> blocks hidden_error · <execution>/<session>`.
examples: task-8b04e9ab726697dd653a743b · dev-go (dev) · 4 of 6 blocks hidden_error · exec-1/sess-1

seq.description: The transcript's row in the control plane.

session.description: The runtime's session id: `axlr-bots execution transcript <execution> <session> --jsonl` prints it whole.

team.description: The bot's team, when it is in one.

blocks.description: How many blocks the transcript was cut into.

flagged.description: The blocks Jev judged hidden_error, in order.

model.description: The pinned Jev version that judged.

excerpt.description: The block's first 400 characters; the whole is in the transcript.

evidence.description: The lines of the block that show a failure, found by fixed rules (forbidden, refused, denied, error, failed, a non-zero exit code, ok false, not found, no such, traceback, panic, timed out, cannot, could not), each cut to 600 characters around the first sign, at most 8: what a reader needs to decide without reading the block. Empty when no line shows one.

VerdictLine.description: One line of the adapter's own file, <state>/transcript-audit/verdicts.jsonl, appended after each transcript it audited: the record of what was judged and how.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the transcript judged.

verdict.description: clean, hidden_error, or skipped (not a session with messages: nothing to judge).

input_tokens.description: What the judgement cost, in Jev's input tokens.

event_id.description: The event the control plane answered, for hidden_error.
